title: Browser Automation for Real Estate Data Migration
boundary: Migrate approximately 4,800+ saved real-estate searches from Google Sheets into authenticated myRealPage IDX with duplicate prevention, retries, checkpoints/resume, status logs, conditional workflows and failed-record review.

blockers: Duplicate identity and conditional account behavior must be observed in the real application.
notes: Freelancer listing was open when checked on 2026-10-03.
